extracted.name: Easy Apple Dumplings
extracted.description: This easy apple dumplings recipe makes sweet biscuit-wrapped apples that float in a buttery vanilla and cinnamon sauce. Delicious with ice cream.
ingredient_lines: 1 (16 ounce) can refrigerated flaky biscuit dough
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Butter a 7 x 11-inch baking pan. Separate dough into 8 pieces; flatten each into a circle. Wrap one biscuit around each apple half; place in the pan, seam-side down.
Combine sugar, water, butter, and vanilla extract in a small bowl. Pour mixture over dumplings; sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake until golden, 35 to 40 minutes. Serve hot.
